description:
Manage your Trinqet client projects and everyday work from ChatGPT. Built for creative freelancers working with multiple clients, Trinqet keeps the work around the work in one clear workspace.

Connect your own Trinqet account to read and manage projects, Daily and Weekly tasks, dated Calendar tasks, Board notes and connections, expense records, project payment records, time entries, and supported workspace settings. Create a task with or without a date, update project status and deadlines, or organize client feedback. Payment and expense tools record bookkeeping information only; they do not charge cards or move money.

Access is limited to your linked workspace. Deletion tools are marked as destructive. Action confirmation is handled by your AI client; no separate Trinqet approval page is required. Owner administration, subscription billing, public sharing, external calendar sync, and email sending are not supported.

defaultPrompt: Show my projects and their next tasks.
Which of my tasks are due this week?
Help me add a next action to one of my projects.
